description.value: Paradise Motel is a 22-unit motel and 15-site RV park in downtown Sicamous, established in 1966 and recently renovated, positioned at the heart of the Shuswap region's year-round recreation scene. The motel features a heated outdoor pool, covered picnic shelter with BBQs, and an on-site laundromat open to both guests and the public with commercial-grade machines capable of handling quilts and sleeping bags. Its central Main Street location puts touring cyclists within walking distance of groceries, dining, and the Shuswap Lake boat launch.

raw_osm.description: Amenities include an outdoor pool and a covered picnic area with barbecues, as well as a playground and a grassy lawn. Parking is complimentary.
raw_osm.name: Paradise Motel

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and richly detailed, confirming the motel's existence, address, and phone number. Amenities listed include 'High Speed Internet'/'Free Wifi' and an on-site laundromat explicitly described as publicly accessible, and the front-page welcome text confirms nearby grocery services. No mention of secure bike storage, bike rooms, or staff bike procedures appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM address has 'sicamous' in lowercase and omits the province; website confirms 'Sicamous, BC V0E 0E8' as the correct full address.
OSM stores the phone number under the 'mobile' tag rather than the standard 'phone' tag, leaving the OSM 'phone' field empty.
Accommodations page contains Lorem Ipsum placeholder text in some room-type description fields, suggesting the website is partially incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable motel in downtown Sicamous with a fully operational website. Straightforward inclusion.

Laundry.detail: On-site laundromat with LG commercial-grade equipment including extra-large machines for quilts and sleeping bags; accessible to both guests and the public; public showers also available at the facility

Nearby grocery.detail: Website states the motel is 'ideally situated in downtown Sicamous' with 'proximity to a plethora of town center services, including groceries'

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states the location offers 'proximity to a plethora of town center services, including... dining' within walking distance
